products.title: Grill Spatula with Green Handle
products.body_html:
This professional-grade spatula features an extended stainless steel shaft for safe handling and an ergonomic grip for comfort and control. The extended stainless steel shaft (18 inches / 45.7 cm) ensures safe handling over high heat, while the ergonomically contoured grip delivers comfort and control during long grilling sessions. Expertly balanced and built to last, this spatula effortlessly flips burgers, maneuvers delicate fish, and tends to searing steaks with equal finesse. It's an essential tool for mastering the art of outdoor cooking, seamlessly integrating with your egg system to enhance every culinary creation.

  • Material: High-grade stainless steel
  • Handle: Heat-resistant, ergonomic polymer
  • Length: 18 inches / 45.7 cm
  • Dishwasher safe
